summary: Initialize Poisson-closed df,E; run nt ordered RK4 steps; compute full field magnitude envelope and peak diagnostic.

capability: Initialize Poisson-closed df,E; run nt ordered RK4 steps; compute full field magnitude envelope and peak diagnostic.
operation: compose the linear Vlasov-Poisson initial-value solve
initial controls -> field envelope, peaks and damping diagnostic
discovery.model: Linear one-dimensional single-spatial-Fourier-mode electrons, fixed ions.
discovery.geometry: One velocity coordinate and one spatial Fourier mode.
discovery.boundary: Composed equilibrium, initialization and evolution path; bounded time window; no convergence or physical validation.

inputs.name: Fn
inputs.description: Distribution family: 1 Maxwellian, 2 kappa, 3 triangular, 4 cutoff slowing-down.

inputs.name: kappa
inputs.description: Kappa shape, used only by Fn=2.

inputs.name: dt
inputs.description: Time step in inverse plasma frequency.

inputs.name: nt
inputs.description: Exact number of ordered time steps.

inputs.name: k
inputs.description: Spatial Fourier wavenumber in inverse Debye length.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Mapping state (complete VP state), envelope, diagnostic, diagnostic_status. For nt=0 envelope and diagnostic are None; inadequate peaks give diagnostic=None and reason while retaining evolution.
outputs.shape: As described in output mapping or tuple.
outputs.constraints: Composed final state and diagnostics; no claim beyond the declared time window and grid.

preconditions: Fn, kappa, nv, dt, nt, k and vmax satisfy vp_init domains.
supported: Initialization, finite RK4 evolution, log envelope, and optional peak diagnostic in one mapping.
excluded: Nonlinear or multidimensional Vlasov-Poisson and post-recurrence continuum claims.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError from initialization, state validation or Poisson closure is propagated.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: FloatingPointError from a nonfinite derivative, field or RK4 state is propagated.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: The diagnostic is optional: insufficient peaks are captured as diagnostic=None with diagnostic_status while the evolved state is preserved.
failure_semantics.partial_results: If evolution fails no result mapping is returned; if only the diagnostic is unavailable, the valid state and envelope are returned.

python.signature: solve_vlasov_poisson(Fn=2, kappa=1.0, nv=2048, dt=0.01, nt=2000, *, k=0.15, vmax=20.0)

example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.vlasov_poisson import solve_vlasov_poisson
r=solve_vlasov_poisson(nv=32,nt=5)
assert r["state"]["dEt"].shape == (6,)
example.description: Run the composed Vlasov-Poisson initialization, evolution and diagnostics for five steps.
example.expected: PASS: .venv/bin/python completed; state.dEt has shape (6,); the optional peak diagnostic may be unavailable for this short trace.

scope: Discrete Poisson constraint and off-diagonal rank-one feedback.
Dense matrix-exponential RK4 order; analytic free-streaming and damped-cosine diagnostics.
Slowing-down weak derivative integration-by-parts and default 2049-node/2000-step execution.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded to the Poisson-closed RK4 Vlasov step and the full-field envelope/peak diagnostic. Evidence: `test_vlasov_poisson_dispersion.py` contains 14 test functions, 1 of which references `solve_vlasov_poisson`, and is shared by 9 assets; only shared-file coverage is bound, so a pass is file-level rather than asset-isolated; the bounded example was executed by this audit. Oracle: independent semidiscrete mathematical checks and selected scenario regressions in the bound file. It does not establish nonlinear or multidimensional Vlasov-Poisson evolution, or post-recurrence continuum claims.
known_limitations: Finite-window rectangle rule and sampling recurrence TR=2pi/(k*dv).
Fn4 truncated density retains original coefficient and is not renormalized after cutoff.
Peak diagnostic assumes standing oscillation; rotating complex exponential has no amplitude peaks.

nodes.description: initialize stage of the initial-value composition.
evolve stage of the initial-value composition.
envelope stage of the initial-value composition.
diagnostic stage of the initial-value composition.
collect stage of the initial-value composition.

edges.transform: Catch insufficient-peak ValueError; preserve reason and None.

execution.mode: Finite initial-value composition with nested finite numerical feedback.
execution.ordering: Initialize then exactly nt ordered RK4 steps; envelope and diagnostic consume completed history; collect results.
branches: Insufficient peaks retain completed evolution and report diagnostic unavailable.
execution.state_ownership: Local copied state; evolve owns its nt-step df/E feedback. Each RK4 stage closes Poisson before the next stage. Bound nt is explicit, no convergence loop.
execution.failure_propagation: Initialization or evolution failure propagates. Unavailable peak diagnostic converts to a reason.
